div.head: Northu 47
div.ab: Ealle we sculon ænne God wurðian ⁊ lufian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle awurpan.
Ealle we sculon ænne God wurðian and lufian and ænne Cristendom georne healdan and ælcne hæþendom mid ealle awurpan.
Alle sollen wir Einen Gott ehren und lieben und Ein Christenthum eifrig halten und jedes Heidenthum gänzlich verwerfen.
We must all honour and love one God and eagerly hold one Christianity and utterly cast off every heathenism.
We must all love and honour one God and zealously hold one Christian faith and entirely cast out every heathen practice.
We must all revere and love one God and fervently adhere to one Christian faith and wholly reject every heathen practice.
div.note: Liebermann compares V Atr 34 and Northu 67 below.
cf. chap. 67; also end of No. 47, and V Ethelred (No. 44) 1 and 34
